actuation_state.consequence: verdict class is capped at CALIBRATION-GO — EXPERIMENTAL/LIMITED
actuation_state.default: OFF — production keeps FuzzyConfig::fixture(); enabling is explicit and versioned
actuation_state.product_fec_actuation: POLICY-ONLY: no product send-path FEC encoder exists (a decode path exists but is default-OFF and unreachable from any product sender). A calibrated FEC recommendation therefore CANNOT be actuated in product today.

ack_confidence.reason: not varied as an independent factor

bandwidth.reason: The authoritative data has NO bandwidth variation (every cell ran a 1 Mbit bottleneck with a 0.80C = 800 kbps pacer). Calibrating this dimension would be unfounded.

jitter.reason: No jitter sweep in the in-process authoritative data; the product grid has a single jitter adversarial slice (n=10), insufficient to calibrate three membership bands.
jitter.runtime_hazard: rtt.rs bootstrap sets rttvar = srtt/2 on the FIRST sample => jitter_ppm = 500_000, which lands in the fixture jitter HIGH shoulder (400k-500k). Any jitter-conditioned rule is therefore untrustworthy until >=2 RTT samples exist. Encoded below as a low-confidence precondition.

loss.defect_corrected: The fixture makes mu_LOW = 1.0 at 200_000 ppm, i.e. 20 % loss is classified fully LOW, so rule R1 (loss LOW -> fec_zero) fires and FEC is never recommended in exactly the region where the authoritative data shows FEC_R2 Pareto-dominates.

queue_delay.reason: no queue-delay variation in the authoritative data

rule_table.STRUCTURAL_LIMITATION: R2 (the only rule that can raise FEC to fec_high) is conjoined with 'bw HIGH', a dimension the authoritative data never varied and which the fixture places at 150-200 kB/s. The tested regime (~125 kB/s bottleneck) does not reach bw HIGH, so even with the corrected loss membership the calibrated policy CANNOT reach fec_high in the supported region. Correcting the loss membership is a NECESSARY but not SUFFICIENT condition for FEC activation. Changing R2's antecedent is a rule-structure change that this calibration deliberately does NOT make without evidence over bandwidth; it is recorded as backlog.
rules: R2: loss HIGH & bw HIGH & jitter LOW -> (fec_high, arq_moderate)
R3: loss MED & bw MED -> (fec_med, arq_med)
R4: loss LOW & jitter HIGH -> (fec_zero, arq_light)
SR1: bw LOW & qd HIGH -> sr_low, complement -> sr_high
EMERGENCY: loss HIGH & bw LOW & ack_conf LOW

safety_requirements.note: Hard caps live in an INDEPENDENT safety configuration; this calibration artifact can never raise them.
required: FEC bytes <= hard_fec_budget; combined overhead <= hard_combined_cap
